reviews.t: So cute, Just examine before you take them out the package;)
reviews.x: So these are such beautiful little earrings, and I was so excited to get them. When I received them in the mail I was at First even more excited because they were just as beautiful in person. Problem is, When I went to check them both out and take them out of the wrapper, One of the rhinestomes were missing. Unfortunately with this style of earing you need a specially long earing to put threw the hole thats big enough to hold the back piece on. Without this rhinestone, My earings were useless:(
Was pretty, but the beads from falling out!!!

reviews.t: Child like earrings! NOT lady like earrings. But still deserves 5 stars
reviews.x: These should be advertised/labeled as "girl, child, or teen earrings" NOT "lady earrings"  Arrived early! After opening, I thought the wrong earrings were sent to me bc they look like child earrings. After looking at my account, I seen I did order them, and clearly didn't look at the style more closely. But I'm keeping them and I'll use them as part of my nieces birthday gift. Great price for cheapie jewelry!!!!
Okay for the price. The earring has plastic cup for attaching to the ear.  The white dot next to the butterfly is dull and looks like a sticker.

reviews.t: This is a "you get what you pay for" sort ...
reviews.x: This is a "you get what you pay for" sort of thing, i didn't expect much...it met my expectations, the stones were stuck on very poorly..it looked sloppy...the shipping and delivery was very prompt and i received it long before the expected delivery date.
Super fast shipping and super cute earrings! Definitely worth the price and more colorful in person

reviews.t: Don't get suckered by Prime for this one. - Listing not a fair representation
reviews.x: The pictures made these look to be better quality than the earrings received. The stones are not seated correctly and are mounted lopsided. It does not appear to be a pearl in the middle but a milky white piece of plastic. The gold color is chipping off and the butterfly is not white as represented but pink. These are very  very inexpensive child earrings. I am disappointed as I paid more under prime to get them quicker based on the listing.

I absolutely am in love with these earrings! The look is very unique, yet it's not gothic looking. I recommend them if you are a funky creative person looking for something new to try. They are very easy to put on, and if you put on the backing firmly, it stays the whole day without you having to redo anything. It's totally worth buying, and the best part is the low price!

Loved these earrings. They are so different. I always get a compliment when I wear them. Yes you got to get use to putting the set in first then the bottom then the back. More you do it the easier it gets. They are dressy. Do not need to have more holes in your ears. I gave them as Christmas presents and they all loved them. Such a great deal.

So cute, unique, these earrings are a head turner. I've received many compliments on these and people do a double take trying to figure them out. Great price too! They don't always stay straight and I need to check the earring backs periodically to make sure they're secure but other than that these are really cool!

Got it for my daughter and she loves it! She normally doesn't like to wear earrings, but when I showed her she fell in love. It's not like a normal earring so I guess that's one reason she was excited. I would've liked one too, but the design, I feel, is geared towards younger girls.

I would give this 5 stars but 2 of the holes were missing on one of the earrings, so you only had one choice and the other 2 holes were blocked by extra metal.  The other earring had 3 holes to pick from which made it sit better on the ear.

I got a pair of the same exact earrings from a different seller, and they were great. However, these are the same design except even CHEAPER quality (the other ones were cheap too) than the orignal ones I bought. But overall, they are ok.

reviews.t: and they look beautiful as they look in their pictures
reviews.x: These 1Pair Lady Crystal Flower Rhinestone Earrings Front anf Back Ear Stud are as described, and they look  beautiful as they look in their pictures. I just got them today and love them!
Really love these!!!! I get compliments on them from young women which is nice. The price was great. Would recommend for anyone who wants something a little different for their ears!!!!
I loved these earrings and was so excited when they came earlier than expected. However the part of the earing that is a single stud was missing the stone...so I cant wear them :(

reviews.t: They do not look exactly the same. To be ...
reviews.x: They do not look exactly the same. To be more specific, in one of them the flower looks (it is broken) and the same thing with the butterfly. That means they have different shape.

reviews.t: Cute and shipped fast but hard to put on. ...
reviews.x: Cute and shipped fast but hard to put on. The back piece has to be put on the post and then a little plastic piece covers the post to keep it from slipping off.

reviews.t: ... earrings was broken when I got them so I'm disappointed with them
reviews.x: One of the earrings was broken when I got them so I'm disappointed with them. I would not send them back as it would cost more than I paid for the earrings.

reviews.t: Cute but change colors within two wears.
reviews.x: They would get five stars if they was not changing color so fast we have wore them two times and they look very rusted. Really cute when they first came!

reviews.t: Definitely designed for younger girls. Would not pass for ...
reviews.x: Definitely designed for younger girls. Would not pass for "intermediate priced" jewerly. Guess this is a case of you get what you paid for
i bought these as a gift. Both myself and the giftee loved this purchase. They are dainty and cute. I would say they are more for a younger girl.

reviews.t: It's easy to lose the pieces to the earrings
reviews.x: It's easy to lose the pieces to the earrings. Although it is adorable it can easily be fall off your ears. I wouldn't buy it again.

reviews.t: my new favorite pair of earrings
reviews.x: Delivery was faster than expected, only a week! And the earring is cute and unique. Great quality for such a steal. I'm very happy.
They did not come with any backs, which is annoying. The jackets are a little difficult to get right, but that is to be expected.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the earrings cute, unique, and compliment-worthy, often receiving positive attention when worn.
Several reviewers report poor quality, with stones or beads falling out, mounted lopsided, or looking sloppy.
Shipping is frequently praised for arriving early or faster than expected.
Some reviewers note the earrings look childish or are better suited to younger girls rather than adult women.
A few reviewers mention fit or security issues, such as earrings not staying straight or backs needing periodic checking.
